manifest:
[package]
name = "point67-master-oracle"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
publish = false

[workspace]


[dependencies]
serde_json = {version="1", features=["float_roundtrip"]}
ninjars = { git = "https://github.com/alphal00p/ninjars", rev = "0d0d7e7a8033431b60a8580731084742e0655cda" }
ninjars-symbolica = { git = "https://github.com/alphal00p/ninjars", rev = "0d0d7e7a8033431b60a8580731084742e0655cda", features = ["native-masters"] }
symbolica = { version = "3.0.1", default-features = false, features = ["integer-gmp", "float-mpfr", "bincode", "serde", "tracing_max_level_info"] }

[patch.crates-io]
symbolica = { git = "https://github.com/alphal00p/symbolica.git", rev = "e679e8c129ce15ec50c46ffb4ff4b59aeb7813b8" }
numerica = { git = "https://github.com/alphal00p/symbolica.git", rev = "e679e8c129ce15ec50c46ffb4ff4b59aeb7813b8" }
graphica = { git = "https://github.com/alphal00p/symbolica.git", rev = "e679e8c129ce15ec50c46ffb4ff4b59aeb7813b8" }
symbolica-typst-plugin = { git = "https://github.com/symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin", rev = "57b7455b37c30f4f87353c0073e49f5225e937ab" }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1


[[bin]]
name = "master-weights"
path = "src/weights.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "expansion-oracle"
path = "src/expansion.rs"
provenance_note: Build command retained from executed shell; hashes observed after build, before execution.
